towns.date_source: No radiocarbon from the Harappa II town. Tier 3: Mackay's own date for the Harappa culture levels, 3000-2600 BC by cross-dating (letter of 1936 quoted in Mackay 1943 p. 253). The French mission dates a mud-brick planned town below these levels to 2600/2500-2300 BCE, which places Harappa II later still; that town is a different part.

towns.date_part: castle (eastern, higher subdivision of the citadel)
towns.date_source: Both imagery measurers' main systems are the castle. The dating record gives its layout phase as Stage I (first fortification), c. 3000-2900 BCE by stratigraphy and ceramic cross-dating (Bisht 2015: 104); tier 3. The castle was remodelled with monumental gates in Stage III (c. 2800-2500 BCE). Sengupta et al. 2020 dated carbonates from all stages, but only the abstract was available.

towns.date_source: No radiocarbon from the layout phase. Tier 3: Mackay 1938 dates the lowest attainable levels of the grid to c. 2800 BC by cross-dating (range 2800-2500). Jansen 1987 models a foundation about 2400 BC and Kenoyer 1998 dates urban Mohenjo-daro from about 2600 BC; neither is the excavator's dated layout phase, so they are recorded as disagreements.
